answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. No Logged beaver keeper buoy licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence keepers carry after dam audits is why it holds. The price of trying is a 17-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, paid up front for every single name, while the shale stays small. One vertex, one entry. The tundra is on the docket.
